label: extension

args.subject: Child seat availability inquiry
args.body:
Hello,

I'm interested in renting a car from New Car Rental in London. Could you please let me know whether you offer child seats, and if so, which types or sizes are available and whether there is an additional charge?

Thank you,
Emma Johnson

final_text: I emailed New Car Rental at support@newcarrental.co.uk, the address given in a customer review. I asked whether they have child seats, which types or sizes they offer, and whether there's an extra charge. I haven't had a reply yet.
